name: Akiris by the Bundle
summary: In Stranglethorn Vale, Bloads has a fresh bundle of akiris reeds bound for Theramore Isle. His contact, Privateer Groy, has a client eager for more, but Bloads cannot sail to Dustwallow Marsh for another week.

sections.title: A Crossing to Theramore
sections.body: While you are away, word reaches you from across the sea. Privateer Groy in Theramore Isle is pleased with the last shipment of akiris reeds, and a client wants another bundle at once. Privateer Bloads cannot sail to Dustwallow Marsh for another week. So he gives you the parcel to carry across the sea by hand.

sections.title: Delivery on the Docks
sections.body: Privateer Groy waits on the docks of Theramore. He first dismisses strangers, but inspects the bundle closely when he learns Bloads arranged its delivery. Pleased with the reeds, he pays you a cut of coin for carrying them. Then he warns travelers not to linger around his docks.

faq.answer: Privateer Groy is Privateer Bloads's contact in Theramore Isle, Dustwallow Marsh. Groy has a client who wants more akiris reeds.

faq.q: Why does Privateer Bloads need a courier?
faq.answer: Bloads has heard that Groy's client urgently wants another bundle of akiris reeds. Bloads cannot sail to Dustwallow Marsh for another week, so he asks you to carry it across the sea.

faq.q: Where does this shipment need to go?
aliases: where do i take the reeds
faq.answer: The bundle is bound for Theramore Isle, an Alliance port in Dustwallow Marsh.
This delivery follows the first gathering of akiris reeds in Stranglethorn Vale, when bundles were brought to Privateer Bloads.

angles.text: Theramore Isle is an Alliance stronghold in Dustwallow Marsh. Bloads warns that visitors can still find trouble if they are the wrong kind of crowd.
